claims.disproof_condition: 條件：到 2027-06-30，Credo 或 Jabil 都沒有文件寫出 Cardinal 的 LRO DSP 進入量產或出貨；或 Jabil 的 1.6T LRO 模組公開改用別家 DSP。核查頻率：每季（Credo 法說、Jabil 法說與新聞稿）。觸發後 48 小時：這份文件撐的那一筆 assertion 降 confidence 或提撤回；重讀 LRO 層讀圖的供給側。
claims.statement: Credo press release (2026-03-17): its second-generation 1.6T optical DSP family Cardinal 'consists of dedicated DSPs for full-retimed and linear receive optics (LRO) applications', and 'Credo is now sampling the Cardinal DSP family to lead customers' (qualification stage: sampling, for this generation only). A Jabil photonics VP is quoted saying Cardinal's LRO solution 'will be a critical enabler' for Jabil's ultra-low-power optics — a forward-looking statement printed in the supplier's own release, not a purchase or design-in disclosure.

source_doc.permission_basis: 公司投資人關係網站公開新聞稿；只保留研究必要的有限逐字節錄。published_at 取頁面正文日期「March 17, 2026」。
source_doc.publisher: Credo 投資人關係網站（Business Wire 稿）
source_doc.title: Credo 新聞稿（2026-03-17）〈Credo Introduces Cardinal: A Low‑Power 1.6T Optical DSP Family Engineered for Massive‑Scale AI Fabrics〉：Cardinal 系列有全重定時與 LRO 專用 DSP、正在送樣主要客戶；Jabil 光子事業 VP 前瞻引言

sources.quote: The Cardinal family consists of dedicated DSPs for full-retimed and linear receive optics (LRO) applications.
Credo is now sampling the Cardinal DSP family to lead customers.

sources.locator: Jabil 引言段（Jason Wildt, VP/GM, Photonics at Jabil）
sources.quote: “Credo’s LRO solution in the Cardinal family will be a critical enabler for our teams to deliver ultra-low power optical solutions designed for rack-scale AI infrastructure,” said Jason Wildt, VP/GM, Photonics at Jabil
